title: Zesty Grilled Jamaican Okra Salad
description: A vibrant, briny salad featuring grilled okra with a glassy-jelly citrus dressing, perfect for a date-night Jamaican vibe.
instructions: Preheat a raclette grill to medium-high heat.
Wash and trim the okra, then pat it dry.
Season the okra with sea salt, black pepper, and drizzle olive oil over it, tossing to coat.
Place the okra on the grill and cook for 3 to 4 minutes per side until charred and tender.
In a small bowl whisk the lime juice, lime zest, minced garlic, honey, and coconut water until glossy.
Toss the grilled okra with chopped cilantro.
Drizzle the vinaigrette over the salad and gently toss to coat.
Add a pinch of sea salt and fresh lime wedges for garnish.
Let the salad rest for 2 minutes before serving to meld flavors.
Serve immediately and enjoy a briny, glassy Jamaican flavor.
